seo.title: TAO Philippines: El Nido to Coron by Bangka and Island Camp | James Wild & Co
seo.description: TAO Philippines runs the original Palawan island expedition, since 2006: four or six days by local bangka between El Nido and Coron, nights in TAO's own off grid bamboo basecamps, with an island-born crew.

tagline: Four or six days by local bangka between El Nido and Coron, sleeping in TAO's own island camps.
answer: TAO Philippines has run island expeditions in northern Palawan since 2006. The Tao Original crosses about 250 km of remote islands between El Nido and Coron in four days and four nights, in either direction, by local bangka with an island-born crew, the Lost Boys, and nights in TAO's off grid bamboo basecamps. The Tao Ultimate adds days in Bacuit Bay for six days and six nights. Joiners are 13 and over unless agreed, with children of all ages on Christmas, Chinese New Year and Easter departures, or any age on a private trip.

overview: TAO calls itself the original Palawan expedition, run since 2006 by a collective of islanders. Guests travel between El Nido and Coron through West Busuanga, Linapacan and Daracoton Bay on a local bangka, away from the usual island-hopping crowds.

Nights are spent in TAO's own off grid bamboo basecamps, hidden in coves, jungles and island communities, in hand-built tuka huts whose bird-beak curves are shaped for shade and breeze. Tao Beach Farm at Dipnay, TAO's biggest working basecamp, ends the Coron to El Nido route; Camp Ngey Ngey, a private island camp in west Busuanga rebuilt from a typhoon-wrecked resort, ends the El Nido to Coron route.
Days are unhurried: snorkelling coral reefs from the boat, swimming to empty beaches, fishing with the crew, and family-style meals of farm vegetables and fresh seafood from a small galley.
why: The most characterful way between the house's two Palawan hubs, El Nido and Coron: four or six days by bangka through islands no resort reaches, with nights in TAO's own camps.
Run by islanders, with the Lost Boys crew and the Tao Women's Association, and a business that invests in local education and livelihoods.

faqs: How long is the TAO expedition?
The Tao Original is four days and four nights between El Nido and Coron, in either direction. The Tao Ultimate is six days and six nights, adding days in Bacuit Bay.

In TAO's own off grid bamboo basecamps, in open-sided tuka huts. The El Nido to Coron route ends at Camp Ngey Ngey, TAO's private island camp in west Busuanga; the Coron to El Nido route ends at Tao Beach Farm in Dipnay.
The El Nido route starts with a group briefing at the Tao office in El Nido at 18:00 the evening before, then a 07:30 departure. It arrives in Coron town at about noon on the last day.
13 for joiners unless agreed in advance, with no upper limit. Children of all ages join on Christmas, Chinese New Year and Easter departures, and private trips take any age.
Can we book a private trip?
Yes. TAO runs an El Nido Private Adventure and a Busuanga Private Adventure, with your own boat, crew and route.
Can you add nights at the end?
Yes. TAO offers extra nights at Camp Ngey Ngey or Tao Beach Farm, added from the booking.
